title: SpermYOLO: A Coordinated YOLO-Based Detector for Accurate and Efficient Sperm and Impurity Detection in Microscopic Images
abstract: arXiv:2609.14278v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate sperm detection is essential for computer-assisted semen analysis, yet it remains challenging in microscopic images due to dense distributions, visually similar artifacts, and sperm-like impurities. In this paper, we propose SpermYOLO, a coordinated and compact YOLOv11-derived framework for joint sperm and impurity detection in microscopic images. SpermYOLO introduces four architectural improvements: C3k2-IDB for channel-wise discriminative feature extraction, D2SEM for spatial--spectral semantic enhancement, MFM for adaptive multi-scale feature fusion, and the DESD Head for detail-enhanced shared prediction. Experiments on the SVIA semen microscopic imaging benchmark show that SpermYOLO achieves 97.2\% sperm AP and 75.4\% impurity AP, outperforming generic detectors, dedicated sperm detection models, and improved YOLO variants. translated_title: SpermYOLO：一种基于YOLO的协同检测器，用于显微镜图像中准确高效的精子与杂质检测
translated_abstract: 准确的精子检测对于计算机辅助精液分析至关重要，但由于显微镜图像中存在密集分布、视觉相似的伪影以及类精子杂质，精子检测仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了SpermYOLO，这是一个协调且紧凑的基于YOLOv11的框架，用于显微镜图像中精子与杂质的联合检测。SpermYOLO引入了四项架构改进：用于通道级判别特征提取的C3k2-IDB、用于空间-光谱语义增强的D2SEM、用于自适应多尺度特征融合的MFM，以及用于细节增强共享预测的DESD检测头。在SVIA精液显微镜成像基准上的实验表明，SpermYOLO达到了97.2%的精子AP和75.4%的杂质AP，优于通用检测器、专用精子检测模型以及改进的YOLO变体。与基线模型相比，SpermYOLO提升了精子AP、杂质AP和mAP50等指标。
tldr: 提出基于YOLOv11的SpermYOLO框架，通过四项架构改进实现显微镜图像中精子与杂质的联合检测，精子AP达97.2%、杂质AP达75.4%，性能超越现有检测方法。
en_tdlr: SpermYOLO, a coordinated YOLOv11-based framework with four architectural improvements, achieves superior joint sperm and impurity detection in microscopic images with 97.2% sperm AP and 75.4% impurity AP, outperforming existing detectors.
